events.verdict: Curry (GSW) initiates contact with Doncic (DAL) and dislodges him.
Green (GSW) establishes a screening position Finney-Smith's (DAL) path before the contact. LATR shows Finney-Smith comes at an angle and has to turn his body to get around Green.
RATR shows Curry (GSW) moves along Doncic's (DAL) path during his drive.
[Observable in enhanced video] Finney-Smith (DAL) splits his feet before dribbling.
Jordan (DAL) is in the lane for longer than three seconds before he is imminently exiting.
Jordan (DAL) lands on two feet and moves his left foot, establishing his right as his pivot. He slides his right as he gets his balance, which is a traveling violation.
Jordan (DAL) and Green (GSW) briefly engage and separate during the rebound.
Thompson (GSW) and Jordan (DAL) briefly engage and separate during the rebound.
Green (GSW) makes contact with Doncic's (DAL) side/chest area with an already extended hand, and does not affect Doncic's ability to complete the pass.
Thompson (GSW) places a legal forearm to Doncic (DAL) and moves along his path during the drive.
Iguodala (GSW) places a legal forearm to Brunson's (DAL) side at the start of the drive.
R-Slash shows Brunson (DAL) briefly tangles Iguodala's (GSW) arm, which is extended in front of him, at the start of the drive.
RLS shows Iguodala (GSW) does not get up to ball height and makes contact with Brunson's (DAL) arm affecting his driving shot attempt.

RATR and L-Slash show that after Iguodala (GSW) makes contact with Brunson's (DAL) arm, Green (GSW) makes contact with the ball after it has bounced off the backboard at an angle that could not result in a basket.

Barnes (DAL) extends his arm into Thompson (GSW), dislodging him and affecting his ability to get the pass off before it's blocked. The contact affects Thompson's balance. When a foul and a violation occur at the same time the foul will take precedence.
Doncic (DAL) makes marginal contact with Green (GSW) after Green secures the ball. He does not get a hand or hands firmly on the ball while Green has possession before the timeout is called.
Barnes (DAL) makes marginal contact with Curry (GSW) at the start of the drive and does not affect his SQBR.

Barnes (DAL) maintains a legal guarding position on Curry (GSW) during his driving shot attempt with a legal forearm against his body. R-Slash shows that at the end of his drive, he follows him with his arm, but does not push or dislodge him.
Iguodala (GSW) and Doncic (DAL) briefly engage and separate during the rebound.
Durant (GSW) makes marginal contact with Barnes (DAL) as he loses control of the ball.
Doncic (DAL) commits a take foul on Curry (GSW).
